$comment: Project harness settings — versioned. Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

permissions.$comment-deny: Blanket deny on every .env file, restored deliberately after two attempts to carve out .env.example. Enumerating the real names (.env.local, .env.production, ...) left anything unlisted — .env.staging, .env.vps — readable by construction, which is the wrong default for files .gitignore already treats as secret. A negated glob (.env.[!e]*) is not supported by this matcher and silently blocked .env.example as well. So: deny everything, and read the committed example through git instead, which is not a Read of the path: `git show HEAD:.env.example`. Writing it is separately allowed — protect-paths.mjs exempts .env.example by name. Note the deny covers Read only.
